import zipfile, sys
import dendropy

zip_path = sys.argv[1]
target_file = "981902at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile"

with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zf:
    if target_file in zf.namelist():
        zf.extract(target_file, '.')
    else:
        matches = [n for n in zf.namelist() if '981902at2759' in n and n.endswith('.treefile')]
        if matches:
            zf.extract(matches[0], '.')
            target_file = matches[0]
        else:
            sys.stderr.write('Could not find treefile for 981902at2759 in zip\n')
            sys.exit(1)

tree = dendropy.Tree.get(path=target_file, schema="newick")
pdm = tree.phylogenetic_distance_matrix()
taxa_list = list(tree.taxon_namespace)

with open("patristic_distances.tsv", "w") as f:
    f.write("taxon1\ttaxon2\tpatristic_distance\n")
    for i in range(len(taxa_list)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(taxa_list)):
            dist = pdm(taxa_list[i], taxa_list[j])
            f.write(f"{taxa_list[i].label}\t{taxa_list[j].label}\t{dist}\n")
